full_judgment: 5. Before we advert to the submissions of the learned Counsels of both the parties we refer to the Bangladesh Parjatan Corporation Service Rules, 1980 framed under the provision of Bangladesh Parjatan Corporation Order, 1973 (President's Order No. 143 of 1973) a copy of which has been annexed to the petition as Annexure-E, wherein there is provision for superannuation in rule 54 thereof, the date on which an officer or employee attains the age of 57 years but no provision has been made for retirement upon completion of 25 years’ service Such provision has been provided by Public Servants (Retirement) Act 1974 and section 9(2) thereof provided as follows:
